$comment: Docs navigation per product. Files are paths relative to the product's docs/ folder as synced into content/docs/<product>/. A file listed nowhere (not in groups, not in exclude) still gets a page under the trailing 'More' group, and `npm run check:docs` warns about it. `exclude` maps a file (or a folder prefix ending in /) to the reason it has no page. `page` entries are site-authored pages (see src/pages/[slug]/docs/[doc].astro). Internal pages (plans, research, audits, design notes, maintainer runbooks, agent instructions) are left out by each product's sync-docs.yml; the `exclude` entries for them keep a stale sync from giving them a page.

exclude.development.md: Contributor gate, test selection and packaging notes
exclude.release.md: Maintainer release runbook (signing, notarisation, registry publishing)
exclude.assets/: Notes about image assets, not documentation
exclude.agency.md: Instructions for coding agents working on Rtok
exclude.batch-flex.md: Cost-lever research and planned proxy work, not current behaviour
exclude.model-routing.md: Planned feature note, not current behaviour
exclude.report.md: Internal survey of PDF renderer candidates
exclude.windows.md: Contributor notes for running the gate on Windows
